content.title: Kennametal 271-2889 Drill Bit, 8.5 mm Cutting Diameter, 117 mm Overall Length
content.short_description: Kennametal 271-2889 drill bit with 8.5 mm cutting diameter and 117 mm overall length. Suited for precision hole-making applications requiring this specific diameter and length combination.
content.long_description:
The Kennametal 271-2889 is a drill bit designed for hole-making operations requiring an 8.5 mm cutting diameter. The tool has an overall length of 117 mm, sizing it for standard-reach drilling applications.

This part falls under Kennametal's tooling line for industrial cutting applications. Procurement and maintenance personnel should confirm the 8.5 mm cutting diameter and 117 mm overall length against machine tooling requirements and hole specifications before ordering.

Use MPN 271-2889 for cross-referencing against existing tool inventories or CNC tooling databases to verify fit prior to purchase.
